title: Resistors in Series-Parallel Combination
body: Three resistors are connected as follows: R1 = 6 ohm and R2 = 3 ohm are connected in parallel, and this parallel combination is connected in series with R3 = 8 ohm. A 12 V battery with negligible internal resistance is connected across the circuit. Calculate: (a) the total resistance of the circuit, and (b) the current flowing through R3.
source: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Electric Circuits
